I've updated PROGRESS.md. 

**Summary:** The reported quality-gate failure came with an **empty gate-output block** — no failure text was actually rendered, so I had no concrete error to fix. Rather than fabricate a problem or silently mutate files (both worse than an empty gate message), I audited every CI gate that could plausibly be affected by adding a one-line HTML comment to a root `README.md`:

- `lint` (eslint) doesn't process `.md` files
- `typecheck`/`build`/`unit-tests` have no code surface to hit
- `doc-cross-references` scans a fixed allowlist of governance docs — README.md isn't in it, and the new file adds no dangling reference
- `doc-quarantine-banner`, `metadata-index`, `asset-registry`, `guardrail-presence` — none scan README.md (verified by grep)
- No prettier/format config exists

The on-disk file is byte-clean (`<!-- glm-proxy-routing-smoke-test 2026-07-19 -->\n`), not in HEAD, not staged. **I found no underlying issue to fix**, and recorded that honestly in PROGRESS.md rather than inventing a fix.

If the gate genuinely failed, the failure text didn't reach me — paste the actual gate output and I'll address the specific failure directly.
